```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

#Fig 3A
# データの準備
plot_data <- data_27subset %>%
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      state_FDR < 0.05 & activity_FDR < 0.05 ~ "Both significant",
      state_FDR < 0.05 ~ "Disease-state only",
      activity_FDR < 0.05 ~ "Disease-activity only",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  )

# logFCを-3〜3に制限した列を作成
plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    state_plot = pmax(-3, pmin(3, state_logFC)),
    activity_plot = pmax(-3, pmin(3, activity_logFC))
  )

# 列が作成されたか確認
colnames(plot_data)

# 描画順を指定
plot_data$significance <- factor(
  plot_data$significance,
  levels = c(
    "Not significant",
    "Disease-state only",
    "Disease-activity only",
    "Both significant"
  )
)

# 描画順に並べ替え
plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  arrange(significance)

p_NCD4 <- ggplot(
  filter(plot_data, subset == "B05_NCD4"),
  aes(
    x = state_plot,
    y = activity_plot,
    color = significance
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 0.7, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey60") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey60") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Not significant" = "grey75",
    "Disease-state only" = "#0072B2",
    "Disease-activity only" = "#C0392B",
    "Both significant" = "#E89422"
  )) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-3, 3),
    breaks = c(-3, 0, 3)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-3, 3),
    breaks = c(-3, 0, 3)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Disease-state (logFC)",
    y = "Disease-activity (logFC)",
    color = "Significance"
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13)

p_NCD4 <- p_NCD4 +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(
        size = 4,   # Legendのドットサイズ
        alpha = 1   # Legendのドットの透明度
      )
    )
  ) +
  theme(
    # labs() の文字サイズ
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),

    # 軸の目盛り文字サイズ
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),

    # Legendの文字サイズ
    legend.title = element_text(size = 0),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),

    # Legendの位置
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(p_NCD4)

```

#Fig S3A
# データをコピー
df <- copy(data_27subset)

# 5分類の順番を指定
df[, siggroup005 := factor(
  siggroup005,
  levels = c(
    "neither",
    "only_state",
    "only_activity",
    "significant_in_both",
    "discordant"
  )
)]

# 描画順を指定
df$significance <- factor(
  df$significance,
  levels = c(
    "Not significant",
    "Disease-state only",
    "Disease-activity only",
    "Both significant"
  )
)

# 描画順に並べ替え
df <- plot_data %>%
  arrange(significance)

# logFCを-3から3の範囲に収める
df[, state_plot := pmax(-3, pmin(3, state_logFC))]
df[, activity_plot := pmax(-3, pmin(3, activity_logFC))]

# 散布図
p_S3A <- ggplot(
  df,
  aes(
    x = state_plot,
    y = activity_plot,
    color = siggroup005
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ subset, ncol = 9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey60") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey60") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "neither" = "grey75",
    "only_state" = "#0072B2",
    "only_activity" = "#C0392B",
    "significant_in_both" = "#E89422",
    "discordant" = "#9467BD"
  )) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-3, 0, 3)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(-3, 0, 3)) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(
    x = "Disease-state (logFC)",
    y = "Disease-activity (logFC)",
    color = "DEG classification"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  ) +
    guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1)
    )
  ) 

# plotsフォルダーにPDFを保存
ggsave(
  "../plots/Figure_S3A.pdf",
  plot = p_S3A,
  width = 15,
  height = 7
)

```{r}
#Fig S3B
# DEG数を集計
deg_counts <- data_27subset[
  ,
  .(
    Disease_state = sum(state_FDR < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    Disease_activity = sum(activity_FDR < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  by = subset
]

# 結果を確認
print(deg_counts)

# 横長データを縦長データに変換
deg_long <- melt(
  deg_counts,
  id.vars = "subset",
  variable.name = "Signature",
  value.name = "Number_DEGs"
)

# 凡例の順番を設定
deg_long[, Signature := factor(
  Signature,
  levels = c("Disease_state", "Disease_activity"),
  labels = c("Disease-state", "Disease-activity")
)]

# Disease-state / Disease-activityの比で細胞を並べる
deg_counts[, ratio := 
  (Disease_state + 1) / (Disease_activity + 1)
]

cell_order <- deg_counts[
  order(-ratio),
  subset
]

deg_long[, subset := factor(
  subset,
  levels = cell_order
)]

# 棒グラフ
p_S3B <- ggplot(
  deg_long,
  aes(
    x = subset,
    y = Number_DEGs,
    fill = Signature
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.75
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Disease-state" = "#0072B2",
      "Disease-activity" = "#D55E00"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of DEGs",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 60,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 9
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11)
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(alpha = 1)
    )
  )

# plotsフォルダーにPDFを保存
ggsave(
  "plots/Figure_S3B.pdf",
  plot = p_S3B,
  width = 15,
  height = 7
)
```

```{r}
#Fig S3C
# 各細胞のSpearman相関係数
cor_df <- data_27subset[
  ,
  .(
    correlation = cor(
      state_logFC,
      activity_logFC,
      method = "spearman",
      use = "complete.obs"
    )
  ),
  by = subset
]

print(cor_df)

cor_df[, lineage := fcase(
  grepl("^A", subset), "B cell",
  grepl("^B", subset), "CD4 T cell",
  grepl("^C", subset), "CD8 T cell",
  grepl("^D", subset), "DC",
  grepl("^E", subset), "Monocyte",
  grepl("^F", subset), "Neutrophil",
  grepl("^G", subset), "NK cell"
)]

# 相関係数の小さい順に並べる
cor_df <- cor_df[order(correlation)]

cor_df[, subset := factor(
  subset,
  levels = subset
)]

p_S3C <- ggplot(
  cor_df,
  aes(
    x = subset,
    y = correlation,
    fill = lineage
  )
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "B cell" = "#B9F000",
    "CD4 T cell" = "#D00000",
    "CD8 T cell" = "#937957",
    "DC" = "#9BEFF1",
    "Monocyte" = "#24249A",
    "Neutrophil" = "#BDBDBD",
    "NK cell" = "#D8C800"
  )) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Spearman correlation coefficient",
    fill = "Lineage"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 60,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 8
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11)
  )

print(p_S3C)

ggsave(
  "../plots/Figure_S3C.pdf",
  plot = p_S3C,
  width = 11,
  height = 5,
  units = "in",
  device = "pdf"
)
```

```{r} 
#Fig 3B
# データをコピー
df <- copy(data_27subset)

# 細胞ごとにDEG数を集計
fig3b_df <- df[
  ,
  .(
    state_only = sum(siggroup005 == "only_state", na.rm = TRUE),
    activity_only = sum(siggroup005 == "only_activity", na.rm = TRUE),
    both = sum(
      state_FDR < 0.05 & activity_FDR < 0.05,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    shared = sum(
      siggroup005 == "significant_in_both",
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ),
  by = subset
]

# DEGの和集合
fig3b_df[, total_DEGs := state_only + activity_only + both]

# Jaccard index
fig3b_df[, jaccard := shared / total_DEGs]

# 各DEG分類の割合
fig3b_df[, state_prop := state_only / total_DEGs]
fig3b_df[, activity_prop := activity_only / total_DEGs]
fig3b_df[, both_prop := both / total_DEGs]

print(fig3b_df)
# 細胞系統
fig3b_df[, lineage := fcase(
  grepl("^A", subset), "B",
  grepl("^B", subset), "CD4",
  grepl("^C", subset), "CD8",
  grepl("^D", subset), "DC",
  grepl("^E", subset), "Monocyte",
  grepl("^F", subset), "Neutrophil",
  grepl("^G", subset), "NK"
)]

# 3グループに分類（近似）
fig3b_df[, pattern := fcase(
  jaccard > 0.15, "Shared",
  state_only >= activity_only, "Disease-state dominant",
  default = "Disease-activity dominant"
)]

# グループの順番
fig3b_df[, pattern := factor(
  pattern,
  levels = c(
    "Disease-state dominant",
    "Shared",
    "Disease-activity dominant"
  )
)]

# 細胞の並び順
setorder(fig3b_df, pattern, -state_prop)

fig3b_df[, subset := factor(
  subset,
  levels = as.character(subset)
)]

p_top <- ggplot(
  fig3b_df,
  aes(
    x = subset,
    y = total_DEGs,
    fill = lineage
  )
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.85) +
  facet_grid(
    ~ pattern,
    scales = "free_x",
    space = "free_x"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "CD4" = "#D00000",
    "CD8" = "#937957",
    "NK" = "#D8C800",
    "B" = "#B9F000",
    "Monocyte" = "#24249A",
    "DC" = "#9BEFF1",
    "Neutrophil" = "#BDBDBD"
  )) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of DEGs",
    fill = "Lineage"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )

# 縦長データへ変換
fig3b_long <- melt(
  fig3b_df,
  id.vars = c("subset", "pattern"),
  measure.vars = c(
    "state_prop",
    "activity_prop",
    "both_prop"
  ),
  variable.name = "DEGtype",
  value.name = "Proportion"
)

# 積み上げ順
fig3b_long[, DEGtype := factor(
  DEGtype,
  levels = c(
    "state_prop",
    "activity_prop",
    "both_prop"
  ),
  labels = c(
    "Disease-state only",
    "Disease-activity only",
    "Both significant"
  )
)]

# 下段の棒グラフ
fig3b_long$DEGtype <- factor(
  fig3b_long$DEGtype,
  levels = c(
    "Disease-state only",
    "Both significant",
    "Disease-activity only"
  )
)

p_bottom <- ggplot(
  fig3b_long,
  aes(
    x = subset,
    y = Proportion,
    fill = DEGtype
  )
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.85) +
  facet_grid(
    ~ pattern,
    scales = "free_x",
    space = "free_x"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Disease-state only" = "#0072B2",
    "Both significant" = "#E89422",
    "Disease-activity only" = "#C0392B"
  )) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Proportion of DEGs",
    fill = "DEG type"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 60,
      hjust = 1,
      size = 10
    ),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
  )

# 上段：Number of DEGs
p_top <- p_top +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14)
  )

# 下段：Proportion of DEGs
p_bottom <- p_bottom +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 12,
      angle = 60,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14)
  )

p_Fig3B <- p_top / p_bottom +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1.2))

print(p_Fig3B)

ggsave(
  "../plots/Figure_3B.pdf",
  plot = p_Fig3B,
  width = 13,
  height = 7,
  units = "in",
  device = "pdf"
)
```
